title: Animate Absolute Manim Feature Completeness
description: Absolute Manim CE feature completeness: fix render blockers (point_ratio, Typst paths, frame hash), replace all 21 catalog stubs with real behavior, complete mobject/camera/3D catalogs, wire present-core scene bridge and video export. Use isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR in ticket folder.
summary:
Completed absolute Manim CE feature parity for animate technology.

**Render truth** — `point_ratio` path trimming in VSobject.paths(); Typst SVG→BezPath via usvg; frame hash includes transform/opacity/point_ratio; z-order painting.

**Morph + animations** — Pointwise path interpolation; all 21 catalog stubs replaced with real apply behavior; added Shift, ApplyMethod, FocusOn, Blink, TracedPath, ChangeSpeed; fixed with_lag_ratio and scene introducer/remover lifecycle.

**Mobject catalogs** — Ellipse, RegularPolygon, dashed paths, boolean ops, vector fields; DecimalNumber/Integer/Paragraph/Code; 2D Table/Matrix grid; FunctionGraph/ParametricFunction; labeled DiGraph; ThreeDVSobject as Sobject.

**Cameras/scenes** — MovingCameraScene, ThreeDScene, ZoomedScene, VectorScene.

**Video** — CLI (render/preview/flush-cache), preview_scene_window, SRT subtitles, cache LRU.

**Present bridge** — compile_scene_to_assets, real player boot, React sceneHash embed, plugin exportVideoFromDeck.

**Verification** — 80 Rust tests + animate-present TS tests passing (isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR).
